# GitHub Topics for Green Codex

## Primary Topics (Essential)
These topics should be added to the GitHub repository for maximum discoverability:

- **green-it** - Core domain
- **eco-design** - Primary focus
- **sustainable-software** - Main purpose
- **digital-sustainability** - Key theme
- **accessibility** - RGAA coverage
- **web-quality** - Opquast coverage
- **codex-skill** - Platform-specific
- **codex** - Platform

## Secondary Topics (Recommended)
- **software-development** - Context
- **ai-ethics** - Responsible AI component
- **responsible-ai** - Important feature
- **ecology** - Broader context
- **open-source** - License type
- **french** - Language/origin
- **rgEA** - Framework (note: GitHub uses lowercase)
- **opquast** - Framework
- **gr491** - Framework

## Additional Topics (Optional)
- **seo** - Optimization focus
- **performance** - Web performance
- **best-practices** - Guidance type
- **audit** - Use case
- **compliance** - Use case
- **code-review** - Use case

## Current Repository Topics
Check existing topics at: https://github.com/Institut-du-Numerique-Responsable/green-codex/topics

## How to Add Topics
1. Go to repository Settings
2. Navigate to "Topics"
3. Add the topics listed above
4. Save

## Recommended Final Topic List
```
green-it, eco-design, sustainable-software, digital-sustainability, accessibility, web-quality, codex-skill, codex, software-development, ai-ethics, responsible-ai, ecology, open-source, french
```
